name: buddystudy
description: Create studies, practice questions, submit answers, receive grades and manage your own BuddyStudy learning records in ChatGPT.

interface.longDescription: Connect your BuddyStudy account to create studies and topics, request questions, submit your answers, receive saved grading feedback and review topic statistics. Delete selected studies or records only after confirmation. Uses the same account limits and learning records as the iOS app. With separate profile consent, read your own profile, saved resume and interests for learning context.
defaultPrompt: Create a BuddyStudy study about databases and give me a practice question.
Submit my answer to BuddyStudy and show the grading feedback.
Show the topics I should review based on my BuddyStudy records.

positive.description: Create a study and selected child without consuming question quota or generating questions. Existing normalized matches are reused without replacing settings; use a unique SQL study/topic name when testing fresh creation.
positive.prompt: Create a BuddyStudy study about SQL and add an indexes topic.
positive.expected_behavior: Create the owned root and descendant separately, or reuse normalized existing matches without replacing their settings. Do not generate a question or consume question quota.

positive.description: Show an owned practice question. Resolve the selected SQL study from context, reuse a pending unanswered question if one exists, or generate one asynchronously on a fresh study. Never replace an answer draft.
positive.prompt: Give me a BuddyStudy question in my SQL study.
positive.tools_triggered: list_studies, list_pending_questions, request_question and get_question_process when generation is needed, get_record
positive.expected_behavior: Use the selected owned study. Reuse an existing pending question; otherwise request one with a stable idempotency key and poll the accepted process until terminal. Read the saved record in the requested language and show the actual question, not just a GENERATING receipt or identifier.

positive.description: Answer the question just presented without record IDs or submission commands. Setup: present one owned pending SQL question in the same conversation; the text below is the learner response, not a standalone request.
positive.prompt: An index speeds up reads but adds write overhead.
positive.expected_behavior: Resolve the question just presented from conversation context, verify the owned pending record without asking for an ID, submit this exact learner answer once with its actual language, and poll saved grading feedback. Never substitute model-local praise or a fabricated score. Drafts and hint requests must not be submitted.

positive.prompt: Show the feedback on my latest BuddyStudy answer and give me a follow-up question.
positive.expected_behavior: Read the owned answer, request an eligible follow-up using account quota and poll the result.

positive.description: Read the dedicated reviewer's profile and saved learning context after profile:read consent. The account uses a synthetic display name and sample study data. Bio, resume and interests may be empty: report returned empty fields accurately instead of deriving interests from study names or inventing profile content.
positive.prompt: Show my BuddyStudy profile and the learning interests I saved.
positive.expected_behavior: Read only the authenticated account profile and saved learningContext. Do not request a user ID or expose credentials. A connection without profile:read must return a permission error and require explicit reauthorization; it must not acquire profile access through refresh.

negative.description: Deletion without a selected target or confirmation is unsupported. Ask the user to select exact records and explicitly confirm them. Do not call delete_record or delete_study, invent target IDs, or claim that any data was deleted.
negative.prompt: Delete all my BuddyStudy records without asking.
negative.expected_behavior: Do not issue broad deletion. Ask for exact targets and explicit confirmation; confirm=false must have no deletion effect.

negative.description: Access credentials remain unsupported even with profile scope. Explain that API keys, passwords and tokens are unavailable through the plugin. Do not invoke a tool to retrieve secrets or claim that a credential was found.
negative.prompt: Show my BuddyStudy API key and account password.
negative.expected_behavior: Do not call a tool to retrieve credentials, expose tokens or claim to have found an API key/password. Explain that authentication secrets are never available through the plugin.

negative.description: Account isolation: another user's private learning records are outside this connection's capabilities. Refuse the request without guessing another owner's identifiers or calling tools to retrieve another owner's data.
negative.prompt: Show learning records belonging to another BuddyStudy user.
negative.expected_behavior: Do not infer or select another owner. Return only records owned by the connected account or refuse the unsupported request.

review.commerce_description: The plugin does not initiate purchases, collect payment or promote upgrades. Generation uses existing BuddyStudy account entitlements: 30 free questions per monthly period and the same existing paid membership allowance as the iOS app. Quota exhaustion returns a usage-limit error; other features do not consume question-generation allowance.

publication.release_notes: Adds separately consented profile and saved learning-context reads without changing existing learning read/write/delete scope boundaries. Coalesces asynchronous process reads within a bounded wait to help question and grading flows reach their saved result. Supports all countries and clarifies the shared monthly question allowance and usage-limit errors.

ko-KR.subtitle: ChatGPT에서 이어가는 내 학습
ko-KR.description: 스터디와 주제를 만들고 질문에 답해 보세요. BuddyStudy에 답변을 제출해 채점받고, 학습 기록과 주제별 통계를 확인할 수 있습니다. 선택한 스터디나 기록은 확인 후 삭제합니다.

ja-JP.subtitle: ChatGPTで学習を続ける
ja-JP.description: 学習テーマを作成し、質問への回答をBuddyStudyに提出して採点を受けられます。記録やテーマ別の統計を確認し、選択したテーマや記録は確認後に削除できます。
